desc:
PANCAKE MIX AND MORE: Craft deliciously fluffy pancakes, waffles, biscuits, and beyond; An ideal ingredient in your favorite breakfast, dinner, or dessert recipes

ORIGINAL BISQUICK: Make it your go-to mix for pancakes, waffles, biscuits, and more - so many ways to Bisquick; It's the perfect pantry staple

BETTY CROCKER QUALITY: Made with no colors and no artificial flavors, so the great taste of your recipes shines through

CUSTOMIZE CREATIONS: Add toppings like syrup, whipped cream, chocolate chips, butter, fruit, breakfast sausage crumbles, or whatever you dream up

CONTAINS: One 60 oz Large Size box of Betty Crocker Bisquick Original Pancake and Baking Mix; Makes about 90 pancakes
features:
Features

Multi-Use Baking Mix

Ideal for making a wide range of recipes including pancakes, waffles, biscuits, dumplings, muffins, and even savory dishes like chicken pot pie.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Made with clean ingredients to maintain natural taste and quality.

Kosher Certified

Suitable for individuals following kosher dietary practices.

Large Family-Sized Box (40 oz)

Provides great value and enough mix for multiple meals—makes about 60 pancakes.

uick Prep Time

Just add milk, eggs, and oil—no measuring multiple ingredients from scratch.

Benefits

Time-Saving Convenience

Perfect for busy mornings or quick dinners—makes home cooking simple and fast.

Consistent, Fluffy Results

Reliable texture and taste every time, without needing to experiment with homemade ratios.

Versatile in the Kitchen

Great base for both sweet and savory dishes, from breakfast to dinner and dessert.

Kid- and Family-Friendly

Neutral flavor allows for fun customizations like adding chocolate chips, berries, cheese, or spices.

Budget-Friendly Pantry Staple

Long shelf life and multiple uses make it a cost-effective choice for families.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Corn Starch, Vegetable Oil (palm, sunflower, canola, and/or high oleic soybean oil), Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Dextrose, Sugar, Salt, Monoglycerides.
